scope: Selected first attempts for the 16-task repair study, three reported models and two arms; 96 cells.
token_definition: Full tokens are input tokens including separately reported cache reads and cache creation, plus output tokens. GPT-OSS prompt tokens already give its full input. Output tokens include reasoning where reported by the provider.
missing_usage_rule: Native-complete physical attempts use native components verified against the sum of unique per-request usage rows. Where native completion is absent, only saved numeric per-request components are included; such cell and arm totals are lower bounds. Missing components are never described as actual zero usage.
scope_exclusions: Superseded runs, environmental predecessors, attempts 2 and 3, grading, setup, and token budgets are outside these selected-run totals.
